sampling.note: Jul 1-Aug 8, source: Euka.ai. ROI is estimated: samples are matched to videos by creator+product (no direct sample-to-video link exists in the data), and COGS uses product list price as a proxy for true landed cost. Canceled/rejected share (17,936 of 21,798 requested) is unusually high and worth a closer look with the team.

affiliatePerformance.note: GMV/Orders/Videos (creators) and GMV/Items Sold (products) refreshed through Aug 8 via Omni Analytics. LIVE/Video/Showcase GMV split for creators, channel split, sampling ROI, and LIVE stream count refreshed via Euka.ai. Note: Euka's per-creator total GMV differs slightly (~2-4%) from Omni's for the same creators, likely due to different attribution windows - the 'GMV' column above uses Omni; LIVE/Video/Showcase columns use Euka, so they may not sum exactly to the GMV column. Columns still marked '—' (followers, CTR, commission, impressions, target/open collab GMV, refunded GMV) aren't available in either source — pending refreshed Creator List export.
affiliatePerformance.channelSplitNote: Jul 1-Aug 8, source: Euka.ai. Channel sum ($413,579) is ~$3,283 below the platform-reported affiliate total ($416,862) - a small unattributed variance flagged directly by the query, not hidden.
